name: Gua sha stone

lead: Gua sha is a traditional East Asian technique in which a smooth-edged tool, often of jade or rose quartz, is drawn over lubricated skin. A gentler facial version is used in skincare for sculpting and de-puffing.
It is popular on social media as a lymphatic massage and facial contouring step.

paras: The pressure and stroking motion transiently increase local blood flow and move fluid, which can reduce puffiness for a time. No evidence of lasting structural changes to fat or bone has been reported.

Facial use is low risk, though pressing too hard can bruise, and traditional body scraping intentionally raises red marks. The evidence concerns pain relief in the body, which is of low quality, and cosmetic claims for the face have not been substantiated. Results are temporary.
